papers.title: LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出，自回归视频扩散模型在长时间闭环生成中会因误差递归积累而产生视觉、运动、身份和动作一致性漂移，根源在于短训练窗口与长部署时域之间的监督差距。LongForcing 保留短时域教师强制和因果 ODE 蒸馏，仅将最终分布匹配阶段的教师扩展到更长时域，并直接监督学生自生成的连续轨迹。实验表明，延长监督时域可改善文生视频质量、长视频稳定性以及交互式世界模型的动作跟随，并在不改变架构和推理成本的情况下支持最长 24 小时的定性 rollout。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 形式化了监督时域差距，说明短窗口边缘分布匹配无法唯一确定长轨迹，长轨迹训练能够暴露延迟失败。2. 提出 LongForcing，在分布匹配蒸馏中使用扩展时域双向教师监督更长的学生自回归轨迹，无需修改学生架构或增加推理成本。3. 在交互式动作条件世界模型和文生视频任务上进行评估，展示监督时域对动作跟随、视觉质量、语义一致性和漂移控制的影响。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点高度相关：它直接研究自回归、因果、流式和长视频生成中的闭环 rollout 漂移；通过延长在线策略轨迹的教师监督，改善动作条件视觉世界模型的状态保持、动作响应和长期模拟；其方法属于蒸馏和分布匹配范畴，并明确保持实时生成学生的架构与推理成本不变。实验覆盖 60 秒交互式 rollout、30 秒文生视频以及最长 24 小时的定性压力测试，直接对应长时域世界模型和长期视频生成场景。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文承认，延长监督时域并不能自动消除超出训练时域的失败，也不能保证匹配误差必然减小；理论保证依赖教师质量、学生与教师在访问状态上的匹配程度、教师泄漏和从漂移状态恢复的能力。实验中的定量评估主要覆盖 60 秒交互式 rollout 和 30 秒文生视频，24 小时结果属于定性压力测试。论文还指出，当前方法尚未解决持久记忆、层次化规划、目标导向行为和长期推理问题。
papers.abstract_cn: 自回归视频扩散模型已成为长时域世界 rollout 的基础。然而，当生成过程远超训练窗口时，这些模型会出现渐进式漂移：视觉质量下降、运动变得不一致，并且由于生成帧被递归地重新用作上下文，物体身份会逐渐崩溃。我们研究了监督时域差距：短时域蒸馏使后续 rollout 状态缺乏直接监督。我们表明，匹配短窗口边缘分布并不一定能决定长时域行为，而更长的在线策略轨迹能够将延迟失败暴露给训练过程。这促使我们针对长时域世界模型开展大规模时序流形匹配。在此基础上，我们提出 LongForcing，一种将教师监督扩展到学生自回归长时域 rollout 的蒸馏方法。LongForcing 保留短时域教师强制和因果 ODE 蒸馏阶段，同时在最终的分布匹配阶段，用扩展时域的双向教师替代真实分数教师。长时域教师使用标准的分布匹配公式监督扩展的学生自回归 rollout，同时无需修改学生架构，也不增加推理成本。我们在文生视频和交互式动作条件世界模型上评估 LongForcing，取得 85.52 的 VBench Quality 分数，并在第一人称消融实验中将 WorldRoamBench 60 秒动作分数提高了 23.9 分。定性压力测试还对最长达 24 小时的交互式 rollout 进行了采样，远超训练时域。这些结果表明，沿时间轴扩展监督，是迈向长时域世界模型的一项实用步骤。项目网站和代码位于 https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing。

papers.title: OccWAM: Occupancy World-Action Models with Joint Scene-to-Ego Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Occupancy world models provide a structured, metric representation of future driving scenes, making them a promising basis for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing occupancy-aware planners typically couple occupancy prediction and action generation through either hierarchical coupling or parallel multi-task learning. Hierarchical methods use occupancy either as a fully predicted future preceding action generation or as an action-conditioned rollout for trajectory evaluation, whereas parallel multi-task methods predict occupancy alongside planning through a separate branch or auxiliary objective. These interfaces retain either an explicit generation order or a role asymmetry, limiting reciprocal interaction between world prediction and action generation during trajectory formation. We propose OccWAM, an occupancy-native world-action model that jointly generates dense future occupancy and continuous ego trajectories via flow matching conditioned on scene representations. Building on this joint formulation, we introduce scene-to-ego world-action flow matching, a two-stage formulation. The first stage predicts scene-centric occupancy together with an absolute ego trajectory, providing a stable representation of future scene evolution. The same predicted world is then re-indexed into the future ego frames induced by the initial trajectory, where ego motion is represented through adjacent pose increments and a second joint flow refines ego-centric occupancy and motion for action-aligned planning. Unlike video-based world-action models, OccWAM preserves explicit semantic geometry for direct planning reasoning without pixel synthesis. Extensive experiments on Bench2Drive and nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in closed-loop driving, open-loop planning, and future occupancy prediction.
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 OccWAM，将稠密度量占用与连续自车轨迹置于同一个条件流匹配生成过程中。模型采用共享的三专家 Mixture-of-Transformers，使世界专家与动作专家在每一层双向交换信息。两阶段场景到自车流程先在固定场景坐标系中生成占用和绝对轨迹，再依据预测轨迹将占用重索引到未来自车坐标系，并联合细化占用与相邻运动增量。实验显示，该方法在 Bench2Drive 闭环驾驶以及 nuScenes 开环规划和未来占用预测中均达到或超过对比方法。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出以占用为核心的世界—动作模型 OccWAM，通过耦合条件流匹配联合生成稠密度量未来占用和连续自车运动，使占用预测能够直接参与动作生成。2. 提出场景到自车的两阶段世界—动作流匹配：第一阶段生成场景中心占用与绝对轨迹，第二阶段将预测世界重索引到轨迹诱导的自车坐标系，并联合运输占用与自车位姿增量。3. 构建共享三专家 Mixture-of-Transformers，通过逐层双向交互实现世界与动作状态的联合建模。4. 在 Bench2Drive 和 nuScenes 上验证了闭环驾驶、开环规划及未来占用预测性能，并通过消融实验证明了双向信息交互和第二阶段联合细化的作用。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点的关系具体体现在：该工作属于动作条件世界模型和闭环驾驶仿真范畴，显式预测未来场景占用并同时生成自车动作，可用于规划—世界预测的闭环交互。它采用连续流匹配而非离散自回归生成，具有联合生成世界状态与动作的特点；场景中心到自车中心的两阶段变换，以及世界专家与动作专家的双向信息交换，增强了面向未来运动的规划对齐。模型保留显式语义几何而不生成视频像素，因此与视频扩散世界模型存在表示层面的差异。论文没有重点讨论实时生成、蒸馏、稀疏注意力或缓存复用；不过其推理时每个阶段使用一次共享世界—动作骨干，且第一阶段使用单步求解，体现了一定的推理效率设计。
papers.abstract_cn: 占用世界模型能够以结构化、度量化的方式表示未来驾驶场景，因此有望成为端到端自动驾驶的基础。然而，现有的占用感知规划器通常通过分层耦合或并行多任务学习来连接占用预测与动作生成。分层方法要么先完整预测未来占用再生成动作，要么进行动作条件化的展开以评估轨迹；并行多任务方法则通过独立分支或辅助目标，在规划的同时预测占用。这些接口仍然保留了明确的生成顺序或角色不对称性，限制了世界预测与动作生成在轨迹形成过程中的相互作用。我们提出 OccWAM，一种以占用为核心的世界—动作模型，通过以场景表示为条件的流匹配联合生成稠密未来占用和连续自车轨迹。在此联合 formulation 的基础上，我们提出场景到自车的世界—动作流匹配，这是一种两阶段方法。第一阶段在场景中心坐标系中，同时预测占用和绝对自车轨迹，从而提供对未来场景演化的稳定表示。随后，根据初始轨迹所确定的未来自车坐标系，对同一个预测世界重新索引；在这些坐标系中，自车运动由相邻位姿增量表示，第二个联合流进一步细化以动作为对齐目标的自车中心占用和运动。不同于基于视频的世界—动作模型，OccWAM 保留了显式语义几何结构，无需生成像素即可直接进行规划推理。在 Bench2Drive 和 nuScenes 上的大量实验表明，OccWAM 在闭环驾驶、开环规划和未来占用预测方面均取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_cn: CineMem 面向需要流式、长时域生成的自回归多镜头视频生成。作者先将双向视频模型适配为按块自回归生成的多镜头模型，并通过重采样历史上下文缓解训练与推理不一致造成的误差累积。注意力分析显示，历史令牌具有跨帧的语义聚类结构，而不同查询令牌和注意力头对历史记忆的偏好差异显著。基于此，CineMem 使用按相似度在线组织的聚类 KV 缓存，并让每个查询-注意力头独立检索相关记忆簇，同时保留首块和最新块作为锚点。该方法在固定预算下扩大有效历史感受野，减少帧级共享检索的冗余。作者还提出同时评估镜头间语义保持和预期镜头变化是否实现的 PTCS 指标。基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 的实验表明，CineMem 在 15 秒多镜头视频上改善了转场控制、镜头内一致性和镜头间一致性，并在 PTCS 上优于所比较的因果和双向基线；消融实验也验证了聚类记忆和查询级检索的作用。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出 CineMem，将在线聚类 KV 缓存与查询级、注意力头级自适应检索结合，用于受限记忆预算下的自回归多镜头长视频生成。2. 通过注意力分析揭示历史视觉令牌的跨帧语义聚类结构及不同查询-注意力头的异质记忆偏好，并据此设计更细粒度的记忆组织和路由机制。3. 提出带有聚类平衡、分裂与合并、负载惩罚及分配稳定项的在线 KV 缓存，使历史令牌能够动态形成语义相关的检索单元。4. 提出查询-头独立的记忆检索，在相同检索预算下扩大历史信息覆盖范围，并近似完整记忆注意力。5. 提出带重采样历史上下文的长时域自回归适配训练策略，以缓解误差累积和训练-推理差距。6. 提出 VLM 辅助的 Prompt-conditioned Transition-Consistency Score，通过联合衡量语义保持与预期转场实现，更忠实地评估多镜头视频的镜头间一致性。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点高度相关。该工作直接研究自回归、因果、流式和长视频生成，通过块级自回归 rollout 以及历史 KV 缓存实现长程依赖建模；其核心贡献是面向视频扩散自回归生成的稀疏、细粒度记忆检索和缓存复用。在线聚类 KV 缓存减少了完整历史注意力的计算和存储压力，查询级及头级路由扩大了固定预算下的有效历史感受野，属于稀疏注意力与缓存复用方向。方法尤其针对多镜头转场和重新访问场景中的长期语义一致性，而非动作条件视觉世界模型或闭环交互模拟。论文报告的理论计算分析显示，聚类检索总 FLOPs 为 638.82 TFLOPs，低于完整历史注意力的 932.56 TFLOPs，并略低于帧级检索的 650.02 TFLOPs。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文未明确说明局限性。根据论文报告的实验范围可知，验证主要基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、45K 多镜头视频数据集、100 个评估提示和 15 秒视频，尚未证明方法在更长视频、更大模型、更广泛数据分布或真实交互式闭环环境中的表现。在线聚类还会引入额外计算开销，且方法是对完整历史注意力的近似；论文未明确量化其在更长时域下的延迟、显存占用、鲁棒性或聚类失败情形。其 PTCS 依赖 VLM 辅助评估，论文未明确说明该评估协议在不同 VLM、提示词或人工评价下的一致性。
papers.abstract_cn: 自回归视频生成依赖记忆检索来建模长程依赖。对于多镜头生成而言，这一能力尤为关键，因为模型需要在镜头切换时协调大幅度的视觉变化与持续的语义连贯性。现有方法通常在帧级别进行记忆检索，并让所有查询令牌共享相同的历史上下文，忽略了不同查询令牌的信息需求具有异质性，从而导致冗余检索以及历史记忆利用效率低下。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 CineMem：一种面向自回归多镜头视频生成的注意力对齐细粒度记忆检索框架，将在线记忆组织与查询自适应检索相结合。具体而言，受注意力分析所揭示的内在记忆访问模式指导，我们提出在线聚类 KV 缓存，作为覆盖所有历史令牌的记忆组织策略，实现语义感知的记忆分组与更精确的检索。此外，我们引入查询级检索机制，在固定检索预算下提供对历史信息更广泛的访问，从而提升长期记忆利用率。两种设计共同使多镜头视频生成器能够保持镜头切换之间的长程一致性，尤其是在重新访问先前内容的场景中，同时在受限记忆预算下近似实现完整记忆访问。为促进评估，我们进一步提出一套面向任务、借助视觉语言模型的指标，用于忠实评估镜头间一致性。大量实验验证了所提出框架的有效性。

papers.title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models
papers.abstract: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.
papers.summary_cn: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments.
papers.contribution_cn: We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：world model, streaming video；关键词：world model, action-conditioned, interactive, simulation, autoregressive, distillation
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
papers.abstract: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.
papers.summary_cn: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models.
papers.contribution_cn: Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：efficient generation, world model；关键词：world model, video world model, autoregressive, causal video, real-time, few-step
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors
papers.abstract: We present LidarVerse, a real-time unified LiDAR world model for sensor simulation across tasks and sensors. Existing LiDAR simulators largely follow one of two complementary paradigms: reconstruction-based methods preserve the geometry of a captured scene but require lengthy per-scene optimization, whereas generative methods amortize learning across data but lack the consistency needed for long-horizon rollouts. LidarVerse brings both paradigms into a single, unified conditional generative framework. A universal tokenizer maps LiDAR range sequences into a shared latent space, where a bidirectional teacher learns a common interface for conditioning on a LiDAR prefix, an HD-Map, a persistent spatial cache, and optionally, text. Varying the available scene evidence turns the same model into a generator of new worlds, a point-cloud forecaster, or a generalizable resimulator of observed scenes without per-scene optimization. We distill the teacher into a four-step autoregressive causal student and maintain both a rolling temporal K/V cache and a world-aligned spatial cache, enabling persistent long-horizon rollouts with real-time inference at 11 FPS on a single H100 GPU. LidarVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics across all three evaluation protocols, while its tokenizer supports 32-, 64-, and 128-beam LiDAR and generalizes to an unseen scanning pattern. These results demonstrate that generative and reconstruction-grounded LiDAR simulation can be realized within one model, providing the core capabilities for future closed-loop sensor simulation.

papers.title: LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts
papers.abstract: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce \textbf{LoopWAM}, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67\% to 43.33\%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5\% average success on RoboTwin~2.0 and 49.5\% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20\% to 55.56\%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. \href{https://loop-wam.github.io/}{\textcolor{orange}{Project Page}}

papers.title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
papers.abstract: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.

papers.title: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
papers.abstract: A robot needs a world model that predicts how its actions will change the scene and a policy that chooses those actions. Models are usually built and evaluated for only one of these roles, and every robot records its actions in its own format. We ask whether one robot world model can serve both roles across different bodies, and what makes this work. We present GreenWAM, a world foundation model for robotics, together with the recipe that produces it: (1) a shared anatomical action space that describes 20 robot families, from bimanual arms to dexterous humanoids, in common joint coordinates; (2) joint training on these families in visual, action-conditioned and world-action modes; and (3) policies that split an action expert off the generator. As a world model, GreenWAM attains top-tier trajectory, depth and 3D accuracy on WorldArena 1.0, ahead of every world-action model and video generator in our comparison. As a policy, it scores among the top entries of the RoboTwin 2.0 leaderboard, reaches the highest zero-shot LIBERO-plus success among the compared methods and is competitive with dedicated vision-language-action and world-action policies on CALVIN and LIBERO. We further adapt GreenWAM to a real humanoid, where it succeeds more often than policies adapted from $π_{0.5}$ and from Cosmos 3 Edge, and distill it into a single-step policy for real-time control. Controlled experiments yield three findings: robot specialization improves world prediction and control together; an action expert helps when split off at the start of adaptation; and keeping world-model modes during policy adaptation preserves robustness to scene changes.

papers.title: SkipWorld: Latent Skip Planning with Distilled World Models for Efficient Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: World-model-based visual navigation enables action planning by predicting future states under candidate trajectories. However, long-horizon rollout remains challenging: models are often trained with ground-truth visual histories but deployed in closed-loop prediction, and evaluating many candidates with step-by-step rollout is computationally expensive. We propose SkipWorld, a latent skip planning framework for efficient visual navigation. SkipWorld introduces three components: (i) Latent AutoRoll, which trains a world model to recursively roll out future states in latent space, reducing the mismatch between training and closed-loop inference; (ii) SkipDistill, which distills the latent autoregressive model into a skip world model that directly predicts long-stride future latent states; and (iii) Skip-then-Refine Planning, a dual-model coarse-to-fine planner that first filters candidate trajectories with the skip model and then reranks selected candidates with the stronger autoregressive model. This design preserves accurate trajectory evaluation while reducing redundant rollout computation. Experiments on RECON, HuRoN, SCAND, and TartanDrive show that, compared with NWM, SkipWorld reduces the average ATE by 4.2% and RPE by 2.7%, while decreasing planning time by 62.4% with a 2.7-fold speedup.
papers.summary_cn: World-model-based visual navigation enables action planning by predicting future states under candidate trajectories.
papers.contribution_cn: We propose SkipWorld, a latent skip planning framework for efficient visual navigation.
